title: Taṇhā
text: 1-8 Sāvatthi || || Yo bhikkhave rūpataṇhāya uppādo ṭhiti || pe || Yo dhammataṇhāya uppādo ṭhiti || pe || jarāmaraṇassa pātubhāvo || || [page 231] XXVI. 10. 12] UPPĀDA-SAṂYUTTA 231 9-14 Yo ca kho bhikkhave rūpataṇhāya nirodho vūpasamo || pe || || Yo dhammataṇhāya nirodho vūpasamo || || jarāmaraṇassa atthagamo ti || ||
